title: The 0.6 changelog page has one still or clip under every Highlight, and a markdown link in a Highlight ships to the app as plain text
steps: S1: Run node --test on packages/desktop/tracy-desktop/test/release-notes-page.test.mjs (a markdown link in the notes ships as its text).
S2: Run node --test on apps/tracy-docs/test/changelog-desktop.test.mjs and apps/tracy-docs/test/media.test.mjs (the committed 0.6 page and its media under public/changelog/0.6/).
S3: Run the stable gate dry run script tasks/evidence/desktop-update-policy/media/0.6/check-stable-gate.mjs against the committed 0.6 page.
expect: S1: releaseNotesFromPage turns `[docs.tracy.ai](https://docs.tracy.ai/)` into `docs.tracy.ai`, still drops media lines and the Desktop only badge; every other release-notes-page test stays green.

S2: every Highlight of 0.6.md has one media line; the four media files (two mp4+gif+poster sets, two webp stills) exist, fit the limits and have their media.json entry with provenance; no unused file.
S3: notesForRelease for variant stable, version 0.6.0 lists no uncovered Highlight.
fence: withoutLinks runs only on the shipped notes (releaseNotesFromPage), after withoutBadge; the page keeps its links; the stable media gate reads the page as committed
